purpose: Provenance registry integration and end-to-end asset-lineage dry run.
registry_rules: Every derivative output must reference a source asset and source revision.
Every render record must identify its engine adapter and configuration.
Actual output checksums are created only after workstation execution.
A dry-run record must never be represented as a real render result.
Failed or unsupported conversions must remain attached to the lineage record.
next_gate: RENDER-11 — automated lineage regression and repository consistency checks.
